name: FUOTY tournament

lead:
FUOTY is a knockout tournament run on looksmax.org in which qualified members' faces are matched against each other and the forum votes on a winner. Each match is a thread, and the user with the most votes after 24 hours advances.
For participants, it is a public, structured way to see how a large audience reacts to their face, and for readers it is a window into which features the community rewards. It is a popularity contest within one community rather than a clinical measurement.

paras: Organisers publish a list of qualified users and a match schedule; each round (round of 16, quarter-finals, semi-finals, third-place match, finals) is a separate thread with the two contestants' photos, and eligible members vote in the thread. Voting windows last 24 hours and votes can be changed during that time.

The format invites harsh public comparison, and threads can attract hostile or offensive replies. Rules exclude newly joined and low-standing accounts from voting to limit manipulation, and tie-breaks go to the user with more reputation points.

angle.text: The tournament offers feedback rather than a change to the face itself: participants and spectators see which faces a large voting audience prefers. Members use such results as a reference point when discussing which features they consider attractive.

lead: FUOTY, short for 'Face of the Year', is an annual tournament on the looksmaxxing forum looksmax.org. Qualified members are placed in a bracket and paired off, and each match is decided by a community vote [1][2].

It connects to looksmaxxing's focus on facial appearance: participants submit their faces to public judgement, and the results show which looks the forum's voters favour. The 2025 edition's matches began on December 23, 2025, with an official qualified-user list and an elimination-round schedule published by the organisers [2].
The description below relies on the rules and match threads the forum itself published; the tournament has received no outside research or news coverage.
infobox: Single-elimination bracket with a third-place match

paras: The 2025 match threads state the same rules. The objective is to hold the most votes at the close of a match to advance. Accounts with a 'greycel' status cannot vote, and accounts that joined after November 14, 2025 ('newcels') cannot vote; both rules are described as measures against using alternative accounts to cheat, and their votes are voided. Voting closes after 24 hours and votes can be changed during that period. Contestants cannot vote for themselves, and a tie goes to the contestant with more reputation points [2][3].
Later rounds in the 2025 edition included semi-finals, a third-place match and a final [1][2][3][4].

The 2025 final was titled as a match between the users Orka and BigBallsLarry, and the third-place match as Menas versus LTNUser. Semi-finals were Menas versus BigBallsLarry and LTNUser versus Orka [1][2][3][4]. Each thread carries accompanying 'match music' and a spoiler listing the full schedule [2].

Replies in match threads mix vote announcements, jokes and commentary about the contestants. Some members say they vote for a contestant because of how they behave on the forum rather than appearance, and in the third-place thread one member says they care about the consolation match even though another dismissed it [2]. Threads can also contain offensive language, which this article does not reproduce.
